caption: The drawing depicts a total of eighteen square and rectangular swatches of patterned fabric, arranged vertically in three columns. The leftmost column contains five swatches featuring various patterns such as florals on a dark background with pink and white horizontal stripes, pink and white horizontal stripes, a large diamond grid on cream, a wavy red and white line with dots, and a dense red and white floral motif. The middle column consists of five swatches including narrow multicolored horizontal stripes with a decorative center band, a diagonal plaid in light red and green tones, a swirling red pattern, a pink swatch with two strawberries, and a beige floral lattice. The rightmost column contains eight smaller swatches; the top row shows a brown square with scattered white and tan shapes, below is a brown and pink motif of small rectangles, a blue floral on white, a red hexagonal floral on pink, a purple and black scattered pattern, a cream square with horizontal lines and small elements, a checkered black, red, and blue pattern, and a red square with small black motifs. The drawing’s background is a light beige with some age discoloration. Each swatch is distinct in design and color, with patterns ranging from geometric, floral, checked, and abstract, primarily in shades of red, pink, brown, black, blue, and cream.
title: Printed Cottons
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
